title: An expected Android dictation refusal is logged to Sentry as an error
whatHappens: The phone speech recognizer refuses, the person sees the right message, but Sentry records an error each time.

observations.text: Sentry BEELINE-MOBILE-R, 1 Nov: 13 events in 24h, 28 lifetime, 0 users. Expected refusal: stop sending it, keep the user message.

fixes.text: Stop sending expected dictation refusals to Sentry; fix corner opened 1 Nov
